message: this error field is specified but the runtime does not produce it yet
why: LANGUAGE.md 7.1.1 declares the field, so it is not a spelling mistake — but the executor's error value does not carry it yet. Accepting the access would compile and then die at run time with `field does not exist`, which is a plain error and cannot be caught: a static checker that passes while the program fails is worse than a refusal.
fix: read a field the runtime already carries (E4016's help lists them per error type)
or read the outcome as a normal value: with `allow_status = [404]` the status comes back on HttpResult<T>, so `r.status == 404` needs no error object at all
